title: Overkiz / Somfy TaHoma (local Developer Mode API)

host.title: Gateway host / IP
host.description: IP address of the TaHoma/Connexoon gateway (recommended) or {PIN}.local. Using the IP avoids frequent disconnections caused by the .local hostname.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Token generated in the Developer Mode menu of the TaHoma by Somfy app (enable Developer Mode by tapping the gateway PIN 7 times).

verifySsl.title: Verify SSL certificate
verifySsl.description: Verify the gateway TLS certificate. Disable when connecting by IP (the self-signed certificate hostname will not match).

ca.title: CA certificate (PEM)
ca.description: Optional Overkiz root CA certificate in PEM format to validate the gateway when 'Verify SSL certificate' is enabled.

pollingInterval.title: Event polling interval (ms)
pollingInterval.description: How often to fetch device state-change events from the gateway.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
